theorem legG_lattice (t : ℝ) (n k : ℕ) :

      = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), legGamma t n j * ((t⁻¹) ^ k) ^ j

name: QHarm.moment_n
statement:
theorem moment_n {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    ((-1) ^ n * t ^ ((n + 1).choose 2))
        * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), legGamma t n j * t ^ j / (t ^ (n + j + 1) - 1)
      = (∏ r ∈ Finset.range n, (t ^ (n + 1) - t ^ (r + 1)))
          / ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (t ^ (n + 1) - (t⁻¹) ^ j)

name: QHarm.moment_tsum
statement:
theorem moment_tsum {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n p : ℕ) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, ((t⁻¹) ^ k) ^ (p + 1) * legG t n ((t⁻¹) ^ k * (t ^ n)⁻¹)
      = t ^ (p + 1)
        * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), legGamma t n j * t ^ j / (t ^ (p + j + 1) - 1)

name: QHarm.norm_sq_eq
statement:
theorem norm_sq_eq {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k * (legG t n ((t⁻¹) ^ k * (t ^ n)⁻¹)) ^ 2
      = legGamma t n n
        * (t ^ (n + 1)
            * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), legGamma t n j * t ^ j / (t ^ (n + j + 1) - 1))

name: QHarm.norm_sq_value
statement:
theorem norm_sq_value {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k * (legG t n ((t⁻¹) ^ k * (t ^ n)⁻¹)) ^ 2
      = t ^ (n + 1) / (t ^ (2 * n + 1) - 1)

name: QHarm.orth_finset
statement:
theorem orth_finset {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n m : ℕ} (hm : m < n) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      legGamma t n j * t ^ j / (t ^ (m + j + 1) - 1) = 0

name: QHarm.orth_moment
statement:
theorem orth_moment {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n m : ℕ) :
    ((-1) ^ n * t ^ ((n + 1).choose 2))
        * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), legGamma t n j * t ^ j / (t ^ (m + j + 1) - 1)
      = (∏ r ∈ Finset.range n, (t ^ (m + 1) - t ^ (r + 1)))
          / ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (t ^ (m + 1) - (t⁻¹) ^ j)

name: QHarm.orth_tsum
statement:
theorem orth_tsum {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n m : ℕ} (hm : m < n) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, ((t⁻¹) ^ k) ^ (m + 1) * legG t n ((t⁻¹) ^ k * (t ^ n)⁻¹) = 0

name: QHarm.orth_tsum_lt
statement:
theorem orth_tsum_lt {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (c : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k * (∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, c m * ((t⁻¹) ^ k) ^ m)
        * legG t n ((t⁻¹) ^ k * (t ^ n)⁻¹) = 0

name: QHarm.summable_lattice
statement:
theorem summable_lattice {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n p : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => ((t⁻¹) ^ k) ^ (p + 1) * legG t n ((t⁻¹) ^ k * (t ^ n)⁻¹))

name: QHarm.legQval_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem legQval_eq_tsum {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    legQval t n
      = ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k * (legVal t n - latVal t n k) / (t ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k)

name: QHarm.pade
statement:
theorem pade {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    legVal t n * (S t - headSum t n) - legQval t n = rem t n

name: QHarm.pade_den_pos
statement:
theorem pade_den_pos {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) :
    0 < t ^ n - t⁻¹ ^ k

name: QHarm.stieltjes_eq_tail
statement:
theorem stieltjes_eq_tail {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k / (t ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k) = S t - headSum t n

name: QHarm.summable_qterm
statement:
theorem summable_qterm {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => (t⁻¹) ^ k * (legVal t n - latVal t n k) / (t ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k))

name: QHarm.summable_rem
statement:
theorem summable_rem {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => (t⁻¹) ^ k * latVal t n k / (t ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k))

name: QHarm.summable_stieltjes
statement:
theorem summable_stieltjes {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => (t⁻¹) ^ k / (t ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k))

name: QHarm.L_le
statement:
theorem L_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k * |latVal t n k| ≤ (1 - t⁻¹)⁻¹

name: QHarm.clrF_le
statement: theorem clrF_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) : clrF t n ≤ t ^ (n * n)

name: QHarm.clrF_pos
statement: theorem clrF_pos {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) : 0 < clrF t n

name: QHarm.clr_mul_rem_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem clr_mul_rem_tendsto_zero {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |clrF t n * rem t n|) atTop (nhds 0)

name: QHarm.latVal_def
statement:
theorem latVal_def (t : ℝ) (n k : ℕ) :
    latVal t n k = legG t n ((t⁻¹) ^ k * (t ^ n)⁻¹)

name: QHarm.summable_sq
statement:
theorem summable_sq {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => (t⁻¹) ^ k * (latVal t n k) ^ 2 / ((t : ℝ) ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k))

name: QHarm.sumsq
statement:
theorem sumsq {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    legVal t n * rem t n
      = ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k * (latVal t n k) ^ 2 / ((t : ℝ) ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k)

name: QHarm.sumsq_pos
statement:
theorem sumsq_pos {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    0 < ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k * (latVal t n k) ^ 2 / ((t : ℝ) ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k)

name: QHarm.abs_partial_moebius_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_partial_moebius_sub_le (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    |(∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, (μ d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2) - 6 / Real.pi ^ 2| ≤ 1 / (N : ℝ)

name: QHarm.abs_triangle_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_triangle_sub_le (N d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    |triangle (N / d) - (N : ℝ) ^ 2 / (2 * (d : ℝ) ^ 2)| ≤ (N : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)

name: QHarm.hasSum_moebius_div_sq
statement:
theorem hasSum_moebius_div_sq :
    HasSum (fun d : ℕ => (μ d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2) (6 / Real.pi ^ 2)

name: QHarm.sum_Icc_cast
statement: theorem sum_Icc_cast (M : ℕ) : ∑ m ∈ Icc 1 M, (m : ℝ) = triangle M

name: QHarm.sum_Icc_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_divisorsAntidiagonal (N : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 N, ∑ p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, F p.1 p.2
      = ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, ∑ m ∈ Icc 1 (N / d), F d m

name: QHarm.sum_inv_Icc_le
statement: theorem sum_inv_Icc_le (N : ℕ) : ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, (1 : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log N

name: QHarm.sum_moebius_mul_id
statement:
theorem sum_moebius_mul_id (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∑ p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (μ p.1 : ℝ) * (p.2 : ℝ) = (n.totient : ℝ)

name: QHarm.sum_totient_asymptotic
statement:
theorem sum_totient_asymptotic :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n →
      |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.totient k : ℝ)) - (3 / Real.pi ^ 2) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2|
        ≤ C * (n : ℝ) * Real.log (n + 1)

name: QHarm.sum_totient_div_sq_tendsto
statement:
theorem sum_totient_div_sq_tendsto :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (Nat.totient k : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
      Filter.atTop (nhds (3 / Real.pi ^ 2))

name: QHarm.sum_totient_eq_sum_moebius
statement:
theorem sum_totient_eq_sum_moebius (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 N, (k.totient : ℝ) = ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, (μ d : ℝ) * triangle (N / d)

name: QHarm.summable_moebius_div_sq
statement:
theorem summable_moebius_div_sq :
    Summable (fun d : ℕ => (μ d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ) ^ 2)

name: QHarm.Dsharp_rpow_tendsto
statement:
theorem Dsharp_rpow_tendsto {P Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hPQ : Q < P) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (((Dsharp P Q n : ℤ) : ℝ)) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2))
      atTop (nhds (((P : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ (3 / Real.pi ^ 2)))

name: QHarm.abs_log_Dsharp_div_sq_le
statement:
theorem abs_log_Dsharp_div_sq_le {P Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hPQ : Q < P) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    |Real.log ((Dsharp P Q n : ℤ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2
        - (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ((Nat.totient k : ℕ) : ℝ)) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2
            * Real.log ((P : ℤ) : ℝ)|
      ≤ ((((P : ℤ) : ℝ) / (((P : ℤ) : ℝ) - ((Q : ℤ) : ℝ))) ^ 2) / (n : ℝ)

name: QHarm.log_Dsharp_div_sq_sub_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem log_Dsharp_div_sq_sub_tendsto_zero {P Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hPQ : Q < P) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
        (Real.log ((Dsharp P Q n : ℤ) : ℝ)
          - (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, ((Nat.totient k : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Real.log ((P : ℤ) : ℝ))
        / (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
      atTop (nhds 0)

name: QHarm.log_Dsharp_div_sq_tendsto
statement:
theorem log_Dsharp_div_sq_tendsto {P Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hPQ : Q < P) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.log ((Dsharp P Q n : ℤ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2)
      atTop (nhds ((3 / Real.pi ^ 2) * Real.log ((P : ℤ) : ℝ)))

name: QHarm.log_Dsharp_le_eventually
statement:
theorem log_Dsharp_le_eventually {P Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hPQ : Q < P) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.log ((Dsharp P Q n : ℤ) : ℝ)
        ≤ ((3 / Real.pi ^ 2) * Real.log ((P : ℤ) : ℝ) + ε) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2

name: QHarm.abs_head_le
statement:
theorem abs_head_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 * gaussConst t ^ 2 ≤ t ^ n) :
    |∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, legCoef t n j| ≤ t ^ degTerm n n / 2

name: QHarm.abs_legCoef_le_degTerm
statement:
theorem abs_legCoef_le_degTerm {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) :
    |legCoef t n j| ≤ gaussConst t ^ 2 * t ^ degTerm n j

name: QHarm.abs_rem_le_sharp
statement:
theorem abs_rem_le_sharp {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 * gaussConst t ^ 2 ≤ t ^ n) :
    |rem t n| ≤ (2 * t ^ (n + 1) / ((t ^ n - 1) * (t ^ (2 * n + 1) - 1))) / t ^ degTerm n n

name: QHarm.degTerm_add_gap
statement:
theorem degTerm_add_gap {n j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) :
    degTerm n j + ((n - j) * n + (n - j).choose 2) = degTerm n n

name: QHarm.degTerm_add_mul_le
statement:
theorem degTerm_add_mul_le {n j : ℕ} (h : j ≤ n) :
    degTerm n j + n * (n - j) ≤ degTerm n n

name: QHarm.degTerm_diag
statement: theorem degTerm_diag (n : ℕ) : degTerm n n = n.choose 2 + n * n

name: QHarm.degTerm_eq_gammaExp_add
statement: theorem degTerm_eq_gammaExp_add (n j : ℕ) : degTerm n j = gammaExp n j + n * j

name: QHarm.degTerm_succ_sub
statement:
theorem degTerm_succ_sub {n j : ℕ} (h : j < n) :
    degTerm n j + (2 * n - j - 1) = degTerm n (j + 1)

name: QHarm.degTerm_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem degTerm_zero_right (n : ℕ) : degTerm n 0 = 0

name: QHarm.eventually_abs_rem_le
statement:
theorem eventually_abs_rem_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      |rem t n| ≤ (2 * t ^ (n + 1) / ((t ^ n - 1) * (t ^ (2 * n + 1) - 1))) / t ^ degTerm n n

name: QHarm.eventually_legVal_lower
statement:
theorem eventually_legVal_lower {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, t ^ degTerm n n / 2 ≤ |legVal t n|

name: QHarm.eventually_legVal_sign
statement:
theorem eventually_legVal_sign {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, 0 < (-1) ^ n * legVal t n

name: QHarm.eventually_threshold
statement:
theorem eventually_threshold {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, 4 * gaussConst t ^ 2 ≤ t ^ n

name: QHarm.half_pow_le_signed_legVal
QHarm.legVal_lower

theorem legVal_lower {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 * gaussConst t ^ 2 ≤ t ^ n) :

name: QHarm.legVal_ne_zero
statement:
theorem legVal_ne_zero {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 * gaussConst t ^ 2 ≤ t ^ n) :

name: QHarm.legVal_sign
statement:
theorem legVal_sign {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 * gaussConst t ^ 2 ≤ t ^ n) :

name: QHarm.one_le_of_threshold
statement:
theorem one_le_of_threshold {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) {n : ℕ}

name: QHarm.pow_degTerm_le_signed_diag
statement:
theorem pow_degTerm_le_signed_diag {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :

name: QHarm.sumsq_le
statement:
theorem sumsq_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, (t⁻¹) ^ k * (latVal t n k) ^ 2 / ((t : ℝ) ^ n - (t⁻¹) ^ k)
      ≤ ((t : ℝ) ^ n - 1)⁻¹ * (t ^ (n + 1) / (t ^ (2 * n + 1) - 1))

name: QHarm.two_mul_degTerm_diag
statement: theorem two_mul_degTerm_diag (n : ℕ) : 2 * degTerm n n + n = 3 * (n * n)

name: QHarm.clr_eq_clrF
statement: theorem clr_eq_clrF (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : clr t n = clrF t n

name: QHarm.clr_mul_form_isInt
statement:
theorem clr_mul_form_isInt {t : ℤ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, clr (t : ℝ) n * legQval (t : ℝ) n
        + clr (t : ℝ) n * legVal (t : ℝ) n * headSum (t : ℝ) n = (a : ℝ)

name: QHarm.clr_mul_legVal_isInt
statement:
theorem clr_mul_legVal_isInt {t : ℤ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) (n : ℕ) :

name: QHarm.clr_pos
statement: theorem clr_pos {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) : 0 < clr t n

name: QHarm.form_eq
statement:
theorem form_eq {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (clr t n * legVal t n) * S t
        - (clr t n * legQval t n + clr t n * legVal t n * headSum t n)
      = clr t n * rem t n

name: QHarm.master_int
statement:
theorem master_int (t : ℤ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    Irrational (∑' n : ℕ+, 1 / ((t : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) - 1))

name: QHarm.rem_ne_zero
statement: theorem rem_ne_zero {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : rem t n ≠ 0

name: QHarm.Aform_decomp
statement:
theorem Aform_decomp (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    legQval t n + legVal t n * headSum t n
      = -(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (j : ℝ) * legCoef t n j)
        + (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), legG t n ((t ^ (r + 1))⁻¹) / (t ^ (r + 1) - 1))
        + (∑ d ∈ Finset.range n, legTail t n (d + 1) * (t ^ (d + 1) / (t ^ (d + 1) - 1)))

name: QHarm.geom_split
statement:
theorem geom_split (ht : 1 < t) (p : ℕ) {d : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    (t ^ (p * d))⁻¹ * (t ^ d - 1)⁻¹ + ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (p + 1), (t ^ (r * d))⁻¹
      = t ^ d / (t ^ d - 1)

name: QHarm.tail_sum_pos
statement:
theorem tail_sum_pos (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.range n, legTail t n (d + 1) * (t ^ ((d + 1) * r))⁻¹
      = (legVal t n - legG t n ((t ^ r)⁻¹)) / (t ^ r - 1)

name: QHarm.tail_sum_zero
statement:
theorem tail_sum_zero (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ d ∈ Finset.range n, legTail t n (d + 1)
      = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (j : ℝ) * legCoef t n j

name: QHarm.eventually_abs_rem_le_crude
statement:
theorem eventually_abs_rem_le_crude {t : ℝ} (ht : 2 ≤ t) :

name: QHarm.ratBase_log_P_pos

name: QHarm.ratClr_le
statement:
theorem ratClr_le {P Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hPQ : Q < P) (n : ℕ) :
    Real.log (ratClr P Q n) = (degTerm n n : ℝ) * Real.log (Q : ℝ) + Real.log (Dsharp P Q n : ℝ)

name: QHarm.ratClr_mul_rem_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem ratClr_mul_rem_tendsto_zero {P Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hPQ : Q < P)
    (ht2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (P : ℝ) / (Q : ℝ))
    (hθ : Real.log (Q : ℝ) / Real.log (P : ℝ) < 1 / 2 - 1 / Real.pi ^ 2) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ratClr P Q n * |rem ((P : ℝ) / (Q : ℝ)) n|)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

name: QHarm.ratClr_pos
statement: theorem ratClr_pos {P Q : ℤ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hPQ : Q < P) (n : ℕ) : 0 < ratClr P Q n

name: QHarm.Rfac_succ
statement: theorem Rfac_succ (t : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : Rfac t (m + 1) = Rfac t m * (t ^ (m + 1) - 1)

name: QHarm.dd_geom
statement:
theorem dd_geom {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n d : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (t ^ j) ^ d / ∏ i ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).erase j, ((t : ℝ) ^ j - t ^ i)
      = if d < n then 0 else gauss t d n

name: QHarm.dd_geom_ge
statement:
theorem dd_geom_ge {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n d : ℕ} (hd : n ≤ d) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (t ^ j) ^ d / ∏ i ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).erase j, ((t : ℝ) ^ j - t ^ i)
      = gauss t d n

name: QHarm.dd_geom_lt
statement:
theorem dd_geom_lt {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n d : ℕ} (hd : d < n) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (t ^ j) ^ d / ∏ i ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).erase j, ((t : ℝ) ^ j - t ^ i) = 0

name: QHarm.gauss_pascal
statement:
theorem gauss_pascal {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n a : ℕ} (ha : a < n) :
    gauss t (n + 1) (a + 1) = t ^ (a + 1) * gauss t n (a + 1) + gauss t n a

name: QHarm.gauss_symm
statement:

name: QHarm.legG_eval_aux
statement:
theorem legG_eval_aux {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n s : ℕ} (hs : s < n) :
    legG t n ((t ^ (n - 1 - s))⁻¹)
      = (-1) ^ n * ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (s + 1),
          (-1) ^ a * gauss t n a * gauss t (n + s - a) (s - a)
            * t ^ ((n + 1 - a).choose 2)

name: QHarm.legG_inv_pow
statement:
theorem legG_inv_pow {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n r : ℕ} (hr : r < n) :
    legG t n ((t ^ r)⁻¹)
      = (-1) ^ n * ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n - r),
          (-1) ^ a * gauss t n a * gauss t (n + (n - 1 - r) - a) ((n - 1 - r) - a)
            * t ^ ((n + 1 - a).choose 2)

name: QHarm.legGamma_prod
statement:
theorem legGamma_prod {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    legGamma t n j * t ^ j * (∏ i ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).erase j, (t ^ j - t ^ i))
      = ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 - t ^ (k + j + 1))

name: QHarm.node_prod
statement:
theorem node_prod {t : ℝ} {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) :
    ∏ i ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).erase j, (t ^ j - t ^ i)
      = (-1) ^ (n - j) * t ^ (j.choose 2 + j * (n - j)) * (Rfac t j * Rfac t (n - j))

name: QHarm.qbinom
statement:
theorem qbinom {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 < t) (n : ℕ) (y : ℝ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ a * gauss t n a * t ^ (a.choose 2) * y ^ a
      = ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 - t ^ k * y)
